purpose: Teach: オルガン/学童/祭壇/観覧/顕微鏡/プレビュー/ガーナ/売れ行き

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、教会の、絶対、オルガン、絶対、聴きに行ったわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, do you remember going to listen to the church organ with such dedication? I really do.
lines.style: Wistful, reaching back through time. Soft opening. Warm but tinged with longing. Peaks gently on the memory before trailing off into quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。昔、本気で、絶対、学童、絶対、まだ、絶対、なかった時代、絶対、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. Back then, when daycare didn't even exist yet. Do you remember, dear? Those days were something else.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact recollection. A slight nod in her voice. Eyes somewhere distant but not sad. Steady cadence like she's holding the memory carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の、本気で、絶対、神社の祭壇、絶対、立派だったわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: The shrine altar was so grand back then. You remember that, don't you? It really was something.
lines.style: Reaching into the past with tenderness. A slight catch on the memory. Asking as though he already knows she remembers. Trails off with quiet certainty, not a question mark.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、観覧車、絶対、二人で、絶対、乗ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、ロマンチック
lines.en: When we were young, we rode the Ferris wheel together, didn't we? Do you remember, dear? It was so romantic—truly magical.
lines.style: Warmth blooming in her voice. A small smile underneath the words. Tender but not fragile. Lingers on 'romantic' with genuine delight, like she's tasting the memory again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、顕微鏡、絶対、まだ、絶対、貴重な時代だったぞ、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, microscopes were still such rare and precious things. You remember that, don't you, dear? Those days were special.
lines.style: Voice softens with the rarity of memory. A gentle emphasis on 'precious.' Spoken as though reliving the smallness and wonder of that time. Trails with quiet reverence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、映画の、絶対、プレビュー、絶対、ネットで、絶対、見られるわよね、あなた
lines.en: Nowadays you can see movie previews online anytime you want. Everything's different now, isn't it, dear?
lines.style: Lighter shift in tone—observing the present with mild bemusement. Not wistful, just noticing. A touch of gentle wonder at how things have changed. Conversational, not reaching back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ガーナ、絶対、世界地図で、絶対、見たわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, I saw Ghana on the world map and it stayed with me. Do you remember? Those little discoveries meant so much then.
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate. A note of wonder at how geography itself felt precious once. Soft attack. Lingers on 'Ghana' as if it carries the whole world in it. Trails with tender certainty.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 創業時、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、商品の売れ行き、絶対、心配したわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When your father started his business, I worried so much about how his products would sell. You remember those days, don't you, dear? We were both so anxious then.
lines.style: Voice settles into shared concern, then warmth. A slight strain underneath—real worry held in the past tense now. Tender because it's over and they made it through. Slower pace. Soft close.
